title: Spirit Stone Ore
text:
Spirit stone ore is a pale blue-gray mineral found in deepslate. Its generation follows diamond rarity, depth distribution and vein sizes.


Use an iron pickaxe or better. Each ore normally drops 1-3 spirit stones and a little experience.


Fortune can increase the yield; Silk Touch preserves the ore block.


Divine Sense reveals these deposits through walls, using the same detection range, shared highlight limit and distance fading as spiritual plants.
